name: Records Too Large To Read Whole
problem: A step that needs something from hundreds of the person's records either puts them all in one prompt, which costs more with every entry and buries what matters, or reads a few and misses the rest, and nothing says which record a statement rests on.
who_has_it: Anyone whose notes, insights and logs have grown past what one prompt holds, and every step of Quest AI that is asked something those records answer.
why_it_matters: A statement that cannot be traced to a record cannot be checked, and a cost that grows with the person's history makes the people with the most to draw on the most expensive to help.
why_hard: What bears on a need is not known until the records are read, a model that summarizes can invent a citation, and the same records are asked about again and again with different needs.
existing_attempts: Pasting everything into one prompt; keyword or vector search that returns a few records without reading the rest; one running summary of the collection that serves no particular need.
